title: Head position after a positive move
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $q$ be one of the $n+2$ valid head positions. After moving in the positive direction, the resulting position, viewed as a natural number, is $\min(q+1,n+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: A position among the $n+2$ valid positions
